title: 第27章 兄弟我包你了第28章 药不是这么做的
content_zh:
看着这一个个脸色大变的技师们，唐吉德立刻就来了兴趣，低声问着他旁边的哥们：“兄弟，你们这是干嘛？见到鬼了么？都吓成了这个样子？”
“见鬼？呵呵！等下你就知道了。”那哥们低声说着。那感觉就好比是老鼠怕看到猫一样。
这时候客户经理又高声喊到：“16号，16号人呢？17号在不在？”
高山站了起来：“我是……”
话音还没有落下，经理就直接道：“那行，就是你了。赶紧的上钟，211房间！”
“先生您好。我是17号技师。”高山一进门，就按照培训的程式化套路开始说话。
房间内一个大约三十岁左右的男子已经坐在了沙发上。约莫一米七五左右的身高，体重估计是两百多斤。满身的赘肉一抖一抖的，胳膊上偶尔露出的纹身，还有那种霸道的气势。一看就是社会人啊。
现在高山算是知道为什么没有技师愿意上这位江总的钟了。从按摩的角度来说，胖子一般是比较受力的类型。受力就意味着同样的服务时间和流程之下，一个胖子客户和一个普通客户相比，技师所需要耗费的力气更多。第二，胖的人穴位和经络难找。这可是真正的中医穴位按摩。跟外面大街上那些小姐姐按摩是两码事。
另外，眼前这位江总满脸的横肉，凶相外露，一看就不是很好说话的人。估计以前没少有技师被他骂过。久而久之这江总就成为了人人想要躲避的客户了。
果然，随着高山的话语落下，江总斜着眼瞟了高山一眼，很是轻率的磕了磕烟灰：“新来的？你这水平行不行啊？不行那我可是要投诉的。”
高山很是自信的笑着道：“您试试不就知道了。”
江总一听，立刻就来了兴致，笑着道：“小伙还挺自信的啊。行，那就试试。”
随着按摩的开始，随着高山一开始上手，江总就有些惊讶的说道：“小兄弟，有一手啊。这力度不多不少，恰到好处，让人很舒服啊。”
实际，这就是高山的厉害之处。现代的中医穴位按摩。手法和技巧都已经消失殆尽了。现在的社会上，外面流行的那些按摩店、足浴城什么的，所谓的手法和技巧，无非就是力度和方法而已。而一般的中医按摩相比之下也就多了一些真正的穴位、经络推拿。可高山的手法却是截然不同的。
别看江总感觉舒服，可高山使用的力度却不是很大，更多的还是一股暗劲，就如同是水平高深的书法家写字一样。看似轻盈却能力透纸背。高山现在就是如此。
随着高山动作的进展继续。江总整个人已经彻底的放松了下来。高山越按，也越是震撼。虽然隔着衣服，却能感受到这个江总身上的伤疤，一条条的刀疤在高山手中都逐一的清晰起来。这时候高山明白为何这江总会人见人怕了。
从西医的角度来说。刀伤或者是枪伤这种，哪怕是康复了。也会影响到身体的健康，往往都会有这种说法，什么年轻的时候，靠着身体还能支持。到老了就有罪受了。
为什么很多革命老战士，或者是参加过实战的军人，受伤之后会有各种各样的病痛。西医的说法是这些创伤导致了肌肉、神经的损伤。
可实际上着就是经络断了。中医历来讲究的就是痛则不通、通则不痛。经络无形无质，穴位无形无质。这两者都是由人体先天带着的气形成的。本来随着后天的生活，这些气就会逐渐的减少甚至消亡。而刀伤或者是枪伤，等于就是人为的切断了经络和穴位的联系。久而久之自然就会疼痛了。
高山的手法看似简单。可却在气术的配合之下，随着按摩的手法，在刺激被按者的穴位和经络。从而达到修复的目的。

……
“大哥，你真不容易啊。”随着高山走进了休息室，唐吉德直接就迎了上来。脸上带着一丝安慰：“大哥，我刚才可是听说了。这个江总可是名人啊。给他按摩不仅仅是累，更关键的是，这人还特别喜欢投诉啊。”
“唐吉德，你真把自己当技师了啊？”李朝康冷嘲热讽起来。
唐吉德一听这话，顿时就眉头一挑，玩味道：“李朝康，你这话可就不对了啊。干一行、爱一行；这是学习，怎么着？听你这个意思，你这是看不起这个职业啊？你看看旁边的这些大哥大姐，哪个不是用双手按出了一个未来。养家糊口，兴业兴家！怎么到了你嘴巴里这就变味了呢？”
唐吉德这小子实在是焉儿坏，这是故意在害李朝康呢。因为随着唐吉德的话语落下，旁边立刻就有技师开口道：“呵呵，我们哪有什么地位啊，都是下贱人，跟你们这些大学生可比不了。”
李朝康脸色铁青，他也知道犯了众怒了。立刻就喝道：“唐吉德你胡说什么。我可没有这个意思。”
看着两人斗嘴的样子，高山此刻却没有半分的兴趣。此刻他发现自己的想法有些错误了。原本以为，自己虽然得到了传承，可毕竟没有经过实践。所以才愿意来这边学习。也可以顺利的拿到实习成绩，拿到文凭。
可现在高山发觉自己有些小看这医门传承了。别的不说，就刚才的按摩手法和认穴精准程度。或许，根本就不需要这么做。而且，高山发现医院可能并不太适合自己。如今的医院，不管是西医也要，中西医结合医院也好，中医院也好，都已经掺杂了太多的西医了。自己这种无疑将会是医院里面的异类。或许，自己开一家小小的诊所，这可能会是最合适的路子。
正想着呢，休息室的大门突然被人直接猛力的推开了，江总那肥硕而霸气的身形已经挡住了大门。江总一出现，立刻就有技师低声道：“坏了。江总这是要发飙了啊。这下我们技师部怕是都要受连累了。”
“就是，就怪十六号。他倒是躲了。这些大学生懂什么啊？学医我们比不上，可要说按摩。十个大学生能有我们厉害。肯定是得罪江总了。”
这些技师们你一言，我一语的议论起来。更是有人看好戏一样的看着高山，他们很想看这些天之骄子出糗的模样。
客户经理也急匆匆的赶来了，一脸笑容，很是恭敬道：“江总，江总您这是干嘛？有什么做得不对的，我给您道歉了。”
江总白了经理一眼，然后看到了高山，顿时眼前一亮，直接就冲了上来，无比热情的伸出手，抓住高山的手，道：“兄弟，你这手法太厉害了。我包你了！”
content_en:
Looking at the technicians whose expressions changed drastically, Tang Jide immediately became interested and asked the buddy next to him in a low voice: "Brother, what are you doing? Have you seen a ghost? Are you all scared like this?"
"What the hell? Haha! You'll find out later." The guy whispered. It feels like a mouse is afraid of seeing a cat.
At this time, the account manager shouted again: "No. 16, where is the person on No. 16? Is No. 17 here?"
Gao Shan stood up: "I am..."
Before he finished speaking, the manager said directly: "Okay, it's you. Hurry up and ring the bell, room 211!"
"Hello, sir. I am technician No. 17." As soon as Gao Shan entered the door, he started speaking according to the stylized training routine.
A man in his thirties was already sitting on the sofa in the room. He is about 1.75 meters tall and weighs about two hundred kilograms. The fat all over his body is shaking, the tattoos on his arms are occasionally exposed, and he has that domineering aura. At first glance, he looks like a social person.
Now Gao Shan finally knows why no technician is willing to work on Mr. Jiang's bell. From the perspective of massage, fat people are generally the type of people who are more stressed. Stress means that under the same service time and process, a fat customer requires more effort from the technician than an ordinary customer. Second, it is difficult to find acupuncture points and meridians for obese people. This is a real Chinese medicine acupoint massage. It's two different things than the massages given by those ladies on the street outside.
In addition, the Mr. Jiang in front of me was full of anger and ferocious looks. At first glance, he was not a very talkative person. It is estimated that many technicians have been scolded by him before. Over time, Mr. Jiang became the customer that everyone wanted to avoid.
Sure enough, as Gao Shan finished speaking, Mr. Jiang glanced sideways at Gao Shan and knocked the ashes frivolously: "New here? Are you good at your level? If not, then I will file a complaint."
Gao Shan smiled confidently and said, "You'll know if you try it."
When Mr. Jiang heard this, he immediately became interested and said with a smile: "Young man is quite confident. Okay, let's give it a try."
As the massage began, and as Gao Shan started to take advantage of it, Mr. Jiang said with some surprise: "Little brother, you have good hands. The intensity is not too much, not too little, just right, making people very comfortable."
In fact, this is the power of mountains. Modern Chinese medicine acupoint massage. Techniques and techniques have all disappeared. In today's society, the so-called techniques and techniques in popular massage parlors and foot bath cities are nothing more than strength and methods. In comparison, ordinary traditional Chinese medicine massage has more real acupuncture points and meridian massage. But Gao Shan's approach is completely different.
Even though Mr. Jiang felt comfortable, Gaoshan didn't use very strong force. It was more of a dark energy, just like a highly skilled calligrapher writing. It looks light but can see through the back of the paper. That's what the mountains are like now.
The progression continues as the alpine action progresses. Mr. Jiang had completely relaxed. The more you press the mountain, the more shocking it becomes. Even through his clothes, he could feel the scars on Mr. Jiang's body. The scars became clear one by one in Gao Shan's hands. At this time, Gao Shan understood why everyone was afraid of Jiang.
From a Western medicine perspective. Knife wounds or gunshot wounds, even if they recover. It will also affect the health of the body. There is often a saying that when you are young, you can still support it with your body. When you get old, you will suffer.
Why do many revolutionary veterans or soldiers who have participated in actual combat suffer from various ailments after being injured? According to Western medicine, these traumas cause damage to muscles and nerves.
But in reality, the meridians are broken. Traditional Chinese medicine has always emphasized that pain will lead to blockage, and generalization will not cause pain. Meridians are invisible and without quality, and acupuncture points are invisible and without quality. Both of these are innate in the human bodyIt is formed with the Qi. Originally, with the development of life, these qi will gradually decrease or even disappear. Knife wounds or gunshot wounds are equivalent to artificially cutting off the connection between meridians and acupuncture points. It will naturally become painful over time.
Gao Shan's approach seems simple. But with the cooperation of Qi techniques and the massage techniques, the acupuncture points and meridians of the person being massaged are being stimulated. So as to achieve the purpose of repair.
…
"Brother, it's not easy for you." As Gao Shan walked into the lounge, Tang Jide greeted him directly. There was a hint of comfort on his face: "Brother, I just heard that. This Mr. Jiang is a celebrity. Not only is it tiring to give him a massage, but more importantly, this person also likes to complain."
"Don Jide, do you really think of yourself as a technician?" Li Chaokang sneered.
When Tang Jide heard this, he immediately raised his eyebrows and said playfully: "Li Chaokang, what you said is wrong. Do a job, love a job; this is learning, what's the matter? Listen to what you mean, you look down on this profession? Look at the big brothers and sisters next to you, who has created a future with both hands. To support the family, to build a business! Why does this change in your mouth?"
This kid Tang Jide is really evil, and he is deliberately trying to harm Li Chaokang. Because as soon as Don Quixote finished speaking, a technician next to him said: "Haha, how can we have any status? We are all lowly people, and we can't compare with college students like you."
Li Chaokang's face was ashen, and he knew that he had offended the public. He immediately shouted: "Don Quide, what are you talking nonsense about? I didn't mean that."
Seeing the two people bickering, Gao Shan was not interested at all at the moment. At this moment he realized that his idea was somewhat wrong. I originally thought that although I had received the inheritance, I had not practiced it after all. That’s why I’m willing to come here to study. You can also successfully get your internship results and diploma.
But now Gao Shan realized that he had underestimated the medical heritage. Not to mention anything else, just the massage technique and the accuracy of identifying the acupoints. Perhaps, there is no need to do this at all. Moreover, Gao Shan discovered that the hospital might not be suitable for him. Today's hospitals, whether they require Western medicine, integrated traditional Chinese and Western medicine hospitals, or traditional Chinese medicine hospitals, have already incorporated too much Western medicine. I will undoubtedly be an outlier in the hospital. Perhaps, opening a small clinic of your own may be the most suitable way.
Just as he was thinking about it, the door to the lounge was suddenly pushed open violently, and Mr. Jiang's fat and domineering figure had blocked the door. As soon as Mr. Jiang appeared, a technician immediately whispered: "It's broken. Mr. Jiang is going to go crazy. I'm afraid our technician department will be affected now."
"Yes, it's No. 16's fault. He actually hid. What do these college students know? We can't compare to us in medicine, but when it comes to massage. Ten college students can be better than us. They must have offended Mr. Jiang."
You talk to these technicians, and I start talking about them. There were even some people who looked at Gaoshan as if they were watching a show. They wanted to see these proud men in embarrassment.
The account manager also hurried over, with a smile on his face and said respectfully: "Mr. Jiang, what are you doing, Mr. Jiang? I have done something wrong. I apologize to you."
Mr. Jiang rolled his eyes at the manager, and then when he saw Gao Shan, his eyes suddenly lit up, and he rushed forward. He stretched out his hand with great enthusiasm, grabbed Gao Shan's hand, and said, "Brother, your technique is so powerful. I'll take care of you!"
